title: Xreal sold 137,200 AR glasses in 2023; revenue RMB 390m (prospectus)
detail: Prospectus figures as reported: 137,200 AR glasses sold in 2023, revenue RMB 390m.

title: Xreal sold 124,900 units in 2024 (Air series ~104,000); revenue RMB 395m
detail: Prospectus figures as reported: 124,900 units sold in 2024, of which Air series about 104,000; revenue RMB 395m.

title: Xreal ships 350,000 AR glasses, 51% worldwide AR share in Q3 2023 (IDC)
detail: PR: 'XREAL (formerly Nreal) Ships Industry-Leading 350,000 AR Glasses, Takes 51% of Worldwide AR Market in Q3 2023' citing IDC.

title: Air 2 Ultra announced at CES 2024 for developers: two front cameras for 6DoF/hand tracking
detail: Air 2 Ultra developer glasses announced at CES 2024 with two front tracking cameras (no photo camera).

title: Xreal One series announced (X1 chip): One US$499 ships 2024-12-25; 12MP Eye module announced
detail: Xreal One series with 'X1 Independent Spatial Computing Chip': One US$499 ships 2024-12-25; One Pro US$599 ships March 2025 (later slipped); Eye camera module announced (12MP, 1.5 g).

title: Xreal 2025: 133,700 units (One series 111,400), revenue RMB 516m, adj. net loss RMB 250m
detail: Prospectus figures: 133,700 units sold in 2025 (One series 111,400 at ASP RMB 3,196; Air 17,400; Light/Ultra/Aura 4,973 at ASP RMB 3,665); revenue RMB 516m (+30.8%); gross margin 35.2%; adjusted net loss RMB 250m; cash RMB 63.63m at year-end.

title: CES 2025: One Pro pre-orders US$599, ship 'before end of Q2'; >500,000 AR glasses life-to-date
detail: One Pro pre-orders at US$599 shipping 'before the end of Q2'; Eye 'coming later this year'; 'more than half a million AR glasses sold life-to-date'; One 'sold out within weeks'.

title: Project Aura announced with Google at I/O 2025: optical see-through Android XR glasses
detail: Xreal and Google announce Project Aura, an optical see-through Android XR device on Snapdragon XR; details promised at AWE (June 10-12, 2025).

title: AWE 2025: Xreal Project Aura shown with 57-degree FOV and 11 mm optics
detail: Tested hands-on coverage; FOV later widened to 70 degrees.

title: One Pro GA 2025-07-01 at US$649; >10,000 pre-orders; Eye ships July 2025 at US$99
detail: PR: One Pro general availability 2025-07-01 at US$649 (pre-order US$599); more than 10,000 pre-orders; Eye camera module ships July 2025 at US$99.

title: Xreal Eye (X7011) ships: 12MP f/2.25, fixed focus, autofocus not supported, 1.35 g
detail: [Verification: partially supported — Spec page confirms X7011, 12MP f/2.25, 2016×1512, 1600×1200, EIS, 1.35 g. It says nothing about focus; 'fixed focus / autofocus not supported' is unsourced. No ship date on page; Xreal said available July 1, 2025.] Xreal de

title: CES 2026: Xreal Project Aura shown, CES Innovation Awards honoree
detail: Later I/O build adds better image quality, hand tracking, cooler puck, GPS, face-detection dimming.

title: Xreal Series D US$100m at ~US$1bn valuation
detail: Series D of US$100m at about US$1bn valuation, 'from supply chain investors' per Reality Atlas.

title: Xreal 1S launched at CES 2026: US$449, 1200p, 52° FOV, 82 g, available same day
detail: Xreal 1S at US$449 (US$50 below One), 1200p, 700 nits, 52° FOV, 82 g, available same day at Amazon/Best Buy; Neo 10,000 mAh DisplayPort power hub US$99.

title: ROG XREAL R1 AR gaming glasses with ASUS announced (H1/Q2 2026 target)
detail: Xreal and ASUS announce ROG XREAL R1 AR gaming glasses, targeted for H1/Q2 2026.

title: Google partnership extended: Xreal 'all-in on Android XR'; Aura X1S, 70° FOV, tethered puck
detail: Xreal deepens collaboration with Google and goes 'all-in on Android XR'; Aura to use X1S chip, 70° FOV and a tethered puck.

title: Xreal files patent-infringement lawsuit against Viture
detail: Xreal PR announces a patent-infringement suit against Viture.

title: Xreal files HKEX listing application; raise up to US$400m; Luxshare, Alibaba shareholders
detail: HKEX prospectus filed with sponsors CICC and Citi; reported raise up to US$400m; shareholders include Alibaba (6.68%), Kuaishou (6.66%), founder Xu Chi (~27.98%), Luxshare Precision, Sequoia China, Shunwei; planned products 'Project Helen' (mass-market), 'R1'

title: AWE 2026: Xreal Aura revealed, 70° FOV, 2 tracking + 1 high-res camera, ≤US$1,500, fall 2026
detail: Aura: 70° FOV, Sony micro-OLED 1920x1200/eye, 120 Hz; puck on Snapdragon 'Reality Elite' + X1S coprocessor; 2 world-facing tracking cameras + 1 high-res camera (privacy LED); 4,455 mAh puck; price 'no more than US$1,500'; fall 2026 launch in 29 countries (US,

title: 'X by XREAL a01+' big-screen AR glasses at US$299
detail: PR launch of the a01+ big-screen AR glasses at US$299.

title: Android Authority Aura hands-on: launch 'before the end of 2026'; 4-5 h streaming battery
detail: Hands-on: launch 'before the end of 2026'; '<US$1,500 does not necessarily mean US$1,499'; 4-5 h streaming battery.
